description: PostgreSQL 18 fixed-length bit strings, literals, casts, operators, functions, ordering, and indexes
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_fixed_bit (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, flags BIT(5) UNIQUE);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_fixed_bit VALUES ('a', B'10101'), ('b', X'3'::bit(5));
SELECT id, flags FROM type_matrix_fixed_bit ORDER BY flags;
SELECT X'A'::bit(5) AS hex_bits, '101'::bit(5) AS padded, '101010'::bit(5) AS truncated, 5::bit(5) AS integer_bits, (-1)::bit(5) AS negative_bits, B'10101'::int4 AS bits_integer;

SELECT B'10101' & B'11000' AS bit_and, B'10101' | B'11000' AS bit_or, B'10101' # B'11000' AS bit_xor, ~B'10101' AS bit_not, B'10101' << 2 AS shift_left, B'10101' >> 2 AS shift_right, B'101' || B'01' AS concatenated;
SELECT bit_count(B'10101'), length(B'10101'), bit_length(B'10101'), octet_length(B'10101'), get_bit(B'10101', 0), set_bit(B'10101', 1, 1);
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_fixed_bit WHERE flags = B'10101';
